name: Ameriprise Financial
description: Ameriprise is mainly a financial-advice firm: more than 10,000 advisors manage client money and get paid fees on it, plus brokerage, bank-deposit interest and cash-sweep income, making Advice & Wealth Management 59 percent of segment revenue and 70 percent of segment profit. Its Columbia Threadneedle arm is a global asset manager with $678 billion under management that earns percentage-of-assets fees, and a smaller insurance and annuity arm (Retirement & Protection Solutions, RiverSource-style products) earns spread and fees on in-force business. Total assets under management, administration and advisement were $1.69 trillion at 2025-12-31. Wikipedia files it under Asset Management & Custody Banks, although most profit is wealth-advice fees.

employees.note: About 13,600 employees (corporate staff and employee financial advisors) plus about 8,500 non-employee advisors in its franchise group; more than 10,000 advisors in the network.

businessLines.name: Advice & Wealth Management
businessLines.how: Clients pay advisory fees, typically a percentage of assets in managed accounts, plus commissions on brokerage and products; the firm also earns net interest on client cash sweeps, bank deposits and certificates. Revenue grows with client asset values, advisor count and interest spreads; AUM $666.4 billion.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), pretax adjusted operating earnings

businessLines.name: Asset Management (Columbia Threadneedle)
businessLines.how: Investors pay management fees, a percentage of assets under management, on mutual funds, institutional mandates and alternatives sold through third parties, advisors and direct; performance fees are minor. AUM $678.1 billion at 2025-12-31.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), pretax adjusted operating earnings

businessLines.name: Retirement & Protection Solutions
businessLines.how: Customers pay premiums and fees for variable annuities and life, disability and long-term-care style insurance; the company earns fees on account values and the spread between investment income and credited interest, with guarantees it must hedge.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), pretax adjusted operating earnings

businessLines.name: Corporate & Other
businessLines.how: Not a business: corporate costs, interest on debt and closed blocks.

brands.name: Ameriprise Financial (advisor network)
brands.note: AUM $666.4 billion in Advice & Wealth Management; total AUM+AUA+advisement $1,694.2 billion at 2025-12-31

brands.name: Columbia Threadneedle Investments
brands.note: global asset-management brand; AUM $678.1 billion (52 percent of total AUM of $1,297.8 billion, before $47.6 billion eliminations)

brands.name: Ameriprise Bank, FSB
brands.note: converted from Ameriprise National Trust Bank in May 2019; takes deposits from advisory clients; size not read
